errors.connection: Cannot reach the hub. Check its address and your network.
errors.not_implemented: This hub does not have this yet ({operation}).
errors.decode: The hub answered in a shape this app does not read ({message}). Update the app or the hub.
errors.signed_out: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.

login.paste_hint: The text of the QR code from Settings → Device connections on the web.
login.invalid_url: Enter the hub address, starting with http:// or https://
login.pairing_invalid: This is not a Core Hub pairing code.
login.pairing_expired: This pairing code has expired. Make a new one on the web: Settings → Device connections.
login.scanner_hint: On the web, open Settings → Device connections → App, and point the camera at the code.
login.camera_denied: Core Hub may not use the camera. Allow it in the iPhone Settings, or paste the code instead.
login.camera_unavailable: This device has no camera. Paste the code instead.

sessions.batch_delete_body: They are deleted for good, with their messages.

chat.no_agent: No agent is available in this profile. Ask an admin to install one.
chat.start_hint: Ask anything. The conversation starts with your first message.

placeholder.title: Coming to the iPhone app
placeholder.body: This page works on the web today; the iPhone app adds it in its next part.

settings.global_note: This page is the whole hub's, not one profile's.

permissions.camera: Core Hub uses the camera to scan the pairing code your hub shows on the web, and to take photos you attach to a message.
permissions.local_network: Core Hub connects to your hub on your local network.
permissions.microphone: Core Hub listens while you dictate a message.
permissions.speech: Core Hub turns what you dictate into text.
permissions.photos: Core Hub attaches the photos you choose to your messages.

agents.gone: This agent is not in this profile any more.

channels.link_on_web: Linking a channel (WhatsApp by QR, a Telegram bot) is done on the web; its state shows here.
channels.qr_body: {platform} links by scanning a code with the phone that has the account. This phone cannot scan its own screen: open the page on the web on another screen (a computer or a tablet) and scan it there.
channels.pairs_note: Anyone else who writes gets a code; you approve them here.

device.push_active: Push is on: the hub sends each notice straight to this phone, even while Core Hub is closed.
device.push_idle: Setting up push with the hub…
device.push_not_allowed: Notices are not allowed, so the hub cannot push to this phone. Allow them to receive notices while Core Hub is closed.
device.push_no_sender: The hub has no iPhone push sender yet (Device connections → Push senders). Until it does, notices arrive while Core Hub is open, and iOS lets it look for new ones now and then while it is closed.
device.push_failed: Push could not be set up just now. Notices arrive while Core Hub is open, iOS lets it look for new ones now and then while it is closed, and push is tried again at the next launch.
device.notifications_denied: Not allowed — change it in the iPhone Settings
device.background_checks: Look for notices while the app is closed (about every 15 minutes, when iOS allows)
device.voice_source_hint: Core Hub uses the profile's speech providers on the hub for dictation and reading replies aloud; when the hub has none, this phone's own voice is used.
device.push_no_sender_short: The hub has no iPhone sender yet
device.notifications_off: Notifications are off for Core Hub

devices.pair_hint: Scan this code from the Core Hub app on another phone to sign it in as you.

models.edit_on_web: Providers and keys are added and changed on the web.

notifications.on_approval: When an agent waits for me

rooms.archived: This room is archived: it can be read, not written in.
rooms.placeholder: Message the room · @ names an agent
rooms.invite_hint: Anyone who may enter this profile can join with the code or its link.
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.no_agents: No agent is installed in this profile.
rooms.lead_hint: The first agent is the lead: it answers a message that names nobody.
rooms.already_member: You are already in this room.

setup.open: This hub has no owner yet and is open to set up now. Make the owner account.
setup.token_needed: This hub has no owner yet. Its setup token is in setup-token.txt in the hub's data folder and in its log.

updates.not_configured: This hub has no update channel set up.
updates.up_to_date: This app is up to date.

share.saved: Saved for Core Hub. Open Core Hub to send it in a new chat.
share.nothing: Nothing here that Core Hub takes: it takes text, links, pictures and files.

voice.denied: Core Hub may not use the microphone or speech recognition. Allow them in the iPhone Settings.
voice.unavailable: Dictation is not available in this language on this phone.
voice.no_speech: Nothing was heard. Try again a little closer to the microphone.
voice.language_auto_hint: Listens in the language of the keyboard you are typing with; without one, in the language of the conversation, then your phone's.
voice.language_hint: Touch and hold to choose the language.

logs.kept: The latest lines of the hub and of every Hermes gateway, kept in the hub’s memory — a restart empties them. Pull down for the newest.

perf.no_proc: This host has no /proc, so the Hermes processes are listed without their numbers.
perf.no_hermes: The hub runs no Hermes process right now.

attachments.too_large: This file is over {size}, the largest the hub takes.

workflows.empty_body: Workflows are drawn on the web; they run and are followed here.
workflows.input_hint: Optional: what this run should work on
workflows.limit_cost_bad: A positive amount, up to two decimals.
workflows.edit_on_web: Steps and links are edited on the web.
workflows.stopped_max_duration: Stopped: it ran past its time limit.
workflows.stopped_max_cost: Stopped: it went past its cost limit.
workflows.stopped_step_timeout: Stopped: a step ran out of time.

board.cannot_drop: That move is not one a person makes here.
board.block_reason_hint: What it needs to go on
board.empty_column: Nothing here. Hold a card to move it.

agent_settings.value_bad: Not a value this setting takes.
agent_settings.empty_is_default: Leave it empty to go back to the agent's own default.

presets.title: Presets
presets.none: No presets yet. Save the current settings to switch back to them later.
presets.skipped: Applied; {count} part(s) no longer exist and were skipped.
presets.name: A name for it

config.shared: These files are shared by every profile of this hub.
config.new_file: The file does not exist yet; saving creates it.
config.changed: The file changed elsewhere since you opened it. Reload it, then make your change again.

models_page.none_body: Add one with a key, or sign in, and every agent of the profile can use its models.
models_page.delete_body: Its key goes too. Agents using its models fall back to the next one.
models_page.local: On your own computer or network
models_page.sign_in_after: You sign in once it is added.
models_page.signed_in: Signed in. Its models are ready.
models_page.sign_in_failed: The sign-in did not finish. Try again.
models_page.sign_in_steps: Open the page, sign in, and type this code there.
models_page.inherited: This profile uses the default profile's models until you choose its own.
models_page.fallbacks: When it fails, try in order
models_page.fallbacks_hint: Drag the handles to change the order.
models_page.speech_none: Add a dictation or speaking provider under Providers.
models_page.voice_sample: Hello, this is how I sound in Core Hub.
models_page.images_none: No provider here draws pictures. Add one that does under Providers.
models_page.images_hint: Agents draw with this model when you ask for a picture.

people_page.password_note: Typed once and never shown again. It ends this person's sessions on every device.
people_page.delete_body: The account, its tokens and its paired devices go. Conversations stay.
people_page.owner_note: The owner account is not edited here.
people_page.username_bad: Two to forty lowercase letters, digits, and . _ -
people_page.admin_can: Manages people, profiles and hub settings.
people_page.member_can: Opens chats and agents in their profiles.

notify_page.quiet_hint: Notices still wait in the inbox.
notify_page.kind_task_moved: A task moved or seems stuck

devices_page.remove_body: It is signed out and has to be paired again.
devices_page.push_sent: Sent. It should arrive in a moment.

usage_page.unreported: {count} runs did not report their tokens.
